title: Staff Engineer-UI
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Staff Engineer who can build new features in Angular 21while also rolling up your sleeves on older code-refactoring legacy components, state management, and API integrations into patterns that actually scale.
  
  
This is a full-time position based out of Kochi.
  
  
***Preferred Location***
Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Build features in Angular 21 using Signals, standalone components, and zoneless change detection
* Dig into older code, understand it, and refactor it into something maintainable
* Contribute to our Angular Material -> Zard UI migration
* Build reactive data flows with NgRx and RxJS
* Build components that look and work great on both mobile and desktop using TailwindCSS and Sass

***Education Requirement***
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Master of Computer Applications.
  
  
***Role and Responsibilities***

* Play a pivotal role in the team, working closely with Product & UX teams, to single handedly own individual modules that are part of an enterprise suite of applications
* Lead the design and solution for refactoring complex legacy codebases
* Play an important role in optimization across solution/architecture/code
* Lead technical conversations with non-engineering stakeholders
* Influence a positive team culture: raising the bar on quality, documentation, and shared ownership
* Define and optimize CI/CD pipelines and automation
* Design, development of scalable enterprise grade applications
* Scoping and breaking down large initiatives into iterative, shippable pieces
* Review code, share knowledge, and help shape how we build things going forward
* Strongly desirable - Having exposure to AI tools to develop UI screens & troubleshoot production issues

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**

* 7-10 years in frontend/UI engineering
* Strong Angular 21 skills for: Signals, Signal Forms, standalone components, zoneless change detection
* NgRx and RxJS
* TailwindCSS and Sass, with a strong grasp of responsive design for mobile and desktop
* Play a pivotal role in the team, working closely with Product & UX teams, to build products that are designed to meet the demands of scale
* Comfortable reading and refactoring complex legacy codebases
* Rich experience in optimization across solution/architecture/code
* Strongly desirable - Having exposure to AI tools to develop UI screens & troubleshoot production issues

**About Dodge Construction Network**
Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
  
  
Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

Role summary
  
  
Owns API and service-layer development for product features, including integration with orchestrator services; owns the Central Orchestrator refactor and extraction — decoupling from dependent services, independent deployability, and horizontally scalable design; owns the HITL Review Framework and AI Security and Trust Layer, covering prompt injection protection, data leakage prevention, content filtering, and policy enforcement; and owns the client's risk-and-lessons-learned system API contract, source grounding and citation pipelines, and advancement of that workflow to launch position.

* Develop and maintain APIs and service-layer integration for product features

* Design for horizontal scalability
* Make agent routing logic testable in isolation
* Build the Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Review Framework
* Implement prompt-injection protection and data-leakage prevention controls
* Implement content-filtering and policy-enforcement controls
* Build and maintain the client's risk-and-lessons-learned system API contract
* Build source-grounding and citation pipelines
* Advance the client's risk and lessons-learned workflow to launch position

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years Python API development experience
* Experience integrating services with a central orchestrator or comparable routing layer
* Experience building document / artifact generation and export endpoints
* Solid REST API design skills
* Senior-level Python engineer with strong system design skills
* Hands-on FastAPI and LangGraph experience
* Proven experience decoupling monolithic orchestration logic into modular, independently deployable services
* 5+ years backend engineering experience with a security / trust-and-safety focus
* Experience with content-filtering or policy-enforcement engines
* Familiarity with human-in-the-loop review workflow design and prompt-injection defenses
* Strong Python skills
* 3+ years data engineering experience with API integration and pipeline design
* Experience with source-grounding / citation pipeline design
* Experience with risk-management or lessons-learned enterprise workflow data a plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with document templating/export libraries
* Familiarity with FastAPI
* Experience extracting a monolithic orchestrator into a standalone, horizontally scalable service under live delivery pressure
* Experience with isolated/unit-testable routing-logic design
* Experience securing an LLM-facing application specifically against prompt injection
* Familiarity with client-style security sign-off processes
* Direct experience inheriting and advancing a partially-built pipeline to production launch position
* Citation/source-attribution pipeline experience

Education
  
  
B.Tech/BCA/MCA in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Software Diagnostics & Performance Test Engineer
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
  
  
*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**What You Will Do**

* Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.
* Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
* Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
* Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.
* Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes.
* Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas.
* Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses.
* Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations.
* Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
* Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
* Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
* Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
* Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
* Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
* Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
* Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
* Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.
* Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis.

**Must-have Qualifications**

* Technical
* 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company.
* Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as Java, C++, C#, Python, etc.
* Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems.
* Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
* Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
* Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
* Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
* Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
* Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.
* Behavioral
* Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
* Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Willingness to challenge assumptions.
* Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
* Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.
* Strong ownership of difficult investigations

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.

We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. title: Staff Architect
description:
We are looking for a Staff Architect to help drive architecture across two connected pillars at organisation: the internal AI engineering platform that accelerates how teams build, and the client-facing product architecture that our customers depend on every day. This is a hands-on, deeply collaborative technical leadership role for someone who has shipped real systems with LLMs and agents, who is comfortable shaping architecture across services, data, security and developer experience, and who is energized by working through other engineers rather than around them.

**The Role**

You will help drive the technical direction of organisation's AI engineering platform and the architecture of our client-facing products. That means partnering with engineering leads, product, security and operations to shape the systems that internal teams build on, the products customers rely on and the AI capabilities that increasingly run through both. You will write code, write design docs, lead reviews, mentor other senior and staff engineers and turn good local decisions into durable enterprise patterns.

This role is intentionally cross-cutting. You will move between platform problems (how engineers and product managers ship faster and more consistently across the company) and product problems (how our client-facing systems scale, integrate, stay secure and incorporate AI in ways that hold up in a regulated industry).

**Key Responsibilities**

**Internal AI Engineering Platform**

* Help drive the architecture of organisation's internal AI scaffolding platform, including agent orchestration, skill and contract design, multi-IDE adapters (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and successors) and the developer experience that ties them together.
* Co-design enterprise-wide standards for building with LLMs and agents: prompt and context patterns, retrieval and grounding, tool integration, evals, guardrails, cost and latency budgets, observability and incident response.
* Partner with engineering leads across product teams to evolve their stacks toward shared scaffolding rather than parallel reinvention, and contribute reusable skills, templates and adapters back to the platform.
* Help shape the evaluation strategy for AI features: how we measure quality, regressions, safety and business impact, and how evals are wired into CI, staging and production telemetry.
* Influence model selection, agent framework choices, vendor versus in-house tradeoffs and where to place the boundaries between platform and product code.

**Client-Facing Product Architecture**

* Partner with product engineering leads to drive the architecture of organisation's client-facing systems across the surfaces customers interact with, including web applications, APIs, integrations and embedded AI features.
* Shape the service architecture: domain boundaries, service decomposition, design platform services, AI services and event-driven patterns.
* Contribute to the data architecture in close collaboration with the Data Architect: how transactional, analytical and regulatory data flows through products, how contracts are defined between systems, how lineage and quality are preserved.
* Help drive the AI in product strategy: where LLMs, RAG, agents and assistive features belong in customer-facing workflows, how they are evaluated, how they fail gracefully and how their behavior is auditable.
* Shape choices around scalability, performance, multi-tenancy and resilience for client workloads, including capacity planning, caching, rate limiting, async processing and graceful degradation.
* Co-design the security and compliance posture for products in a regulated domain: authentication, authorization, tenancy isolation, encryption, secrets handling, audit logging and data residency.
* Influence observability and operability standards: telemetry, logging, tracing, SLOs, on-call ergonomics and incident review.
* Guide integration and interoperability decisions across customer integrations, third-party services, data feeds and partner platforms.

**Technical Leadership Across Both Pillars**

* Lead and contribute to design reviews, architecture decision records and technical writing that sets the bar for the broader engineering organization.
* Mentor staff and senior engineers across teams. Coach them through hard tradeoffs rather than making the calls for them.
* Be the technical voice that helps leadership decide what to build, what to buy and what to retire, and that translates technical reality back to business stakeholders.
* Work with security, compliance and risk to make sure AI-driven workflows and product features meet ORAGANISATION's obligations around data handling, auditability, access control and regulatory exposure.
* Stay close to the broader industry. Bring back practices that are working elsewhere and adapt them to our context.

**Essential Criteria**

* 11+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership at staff level or equivalent cross-team scope.
* Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems built on LLMs or autonomous agents. You can speak in detail to systems you architected, the tradeoffs you made and what you would do differently.
* Strong distributed systems and software architecture background. You can move fluently between service design, API design, data flow, security and developer experience.
* Hands-on experience architecting client-facing SaaS or enterprise products: service boundaries, APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, performance, resilience and observability.
* Working understanding of data architecture: storage choices (relational, document, analytical, vector), data contracts and how product systems and data platforms meet at the boundary.
* Hands-on fluency with modern AI engineering practice: prompt and context engineering, retrieval augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool use, evals and guardrails.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives through influence in a mid to large engineering organization. You can move a group of senior engineers toward shared decisions without relying on positional authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a one-page design doc that aligns a room of senior people and a five-line summary that aligns an executive.
* A pragmatic, collaborative mindset. You balance rigor with delivery, work inside legacy constraints and still move the architecture forward.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building developer tooling or internal platforms at enterprise scale, especially scaffolding, code generation, workflow automation or developer productivity systems.
* **Experience integrating AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) into team workflows as a deliberate engineering practice, not just individual use**
  .
* Familiarity with MCP-style tool integration, agent contracts and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with eval frameworks (LangSmith or commercial/in-house equivalents) and with observability for LLM and agent systems in production.
* Experience designing for compliance, audit and regulatory requirements in financial services, healthcare or another regulated, data-sensitive domain.
* **Familiarity with cloud-native architecture on AWS (or equivalent), containerization, IaC and modern CI/CD.**
* A track record of writing or speaking publicly about software architecture or AI engineering practice.

**What We Offer**

* A senior technical leadership role with scope across both the AI platform that internal teams build on and the products our customers rely on.
* The chance to help define the architectural standards and patterns that hundreds of engineers and product managers will use every day.
* A collaborative, forward-thinking team that takes both engineering rigor and emerging AI practice seriously.
* The opportunity to work at the intersection of regulated financial data and modern AI tooling, where the technical bar and the business stakes are both high.

**The opportunity**
We are looking for professionals with expertise in Microsoft 365 consulting, migration and modernization to join our AI Workforce Consulting team. This is an opportunity to contribute to large transformation programs while supporting the growth of our Microsoft 365 service offerings.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work with client and project teams to understand business requirements, current-state environments and modernization objectives.

* Develop reusable assets, accelerators and best practices for Microsoft 365 migration and modernization engagements.
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

* 5-8 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
* Strong hands-on experience with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), TypeScript, React, Fluent UI, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
* Good knowledge of SharePoint Online architecture, information architecture, permissions, content types, site designs and governance concepts.
* Experience in Microsoft 365 migrations covering SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Teams, including discovery, assessment, remediation, migration execution, validation and cutover.
* Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
* Self-starter with a strong drive to learn and adopt new technologies
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
* Good presentation and client-facing skills
* Ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams
* Collaborative team player with a positive and constructive approach

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 5 years of relevant Microsoft 365, SharePoint, migration or modernization experience.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise in SPFx and Microsoft 365 migration delivery.
* Practical experience with Nintex workflows and forms.
* Strong consulting, documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience in a professional services or consulting organization.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and translate complex requirements into manageable deliverables.
* Ability to operate independently with minimum supervision and support junior team members.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects and support practice build
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reports, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 5-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages- Python, JSON, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification

**Certifications:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

**What We Look For**

* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.
* Produces accurate, maintainable, and well-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.
* Comfortable working in a global environment with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark and manufacturing sites as required.

title: AI Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to design and guide the implementation of secure, scalable, and production-ready artificial intelligence solutions. This role will establish enterprise AI architecture, lead technical design decisions, and support the delivery of machine learning and generative AI capabilities across cloud and enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate combines strong architecture and software engineering experience with hands-on knowledge of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI governance, cloud platforms, and enterprise application integration.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Architecture and Delivery

* Design end-to-end architectures for machine learning and generative AI solutions.
* Lead the architecture and implementation of solutions involving large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent document processing, automation, and predictive analytics.
* Define reusable architectural patterns, reference architectures, and technical standards for enterprise AI.
* Guide engineering teams in developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining AI solutions that support clinical, operational, and administrative use cases.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend appropriate platforms, models, tools, and implementation approaches.

Enterprise AI Infrastructure

* Design and optimize enterprise AI infrastructure across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Define architectural requirements for scalability, availability, security, reliability, and performance.
* Establish deployment, monitoring, and operational standards for AI workloads.
* Support platform health, system performance, capacity planning, and infrastructure readiness.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, security, data, and application teams to ensure architectural alignment.

Enterprise Systems Integration

* Design integration patterns connecting AI capabilities with enterprise applications, data platforms, healthcare systems, and business workflows.
* Define secure interfaces, APIs, data pipelines, and orchestration patterns for AI-enabled solutions.
* Partner with business and technical teams to understand system dependencies and integration requirements.
* Support implementation teams in resolving complex integration and architectural challenges.

AI Governance, Security, and Responsible AI

* Establish AI quality, safety, security, privacy, and governance standards.
* Define evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, validation methods, and monitoring requirements for AI solutions.
* Ensure solutions comply with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and responsible AI principles.
* Identify and mitigate technical, operational, security, privacy, and model-related risks.
* Incorporate human oversight, traceability, and appropriate controls into AI solution designs.

Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as a technical subject matter expert supporting AI strategy, adoption, and solution implementation.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for business and executive stakeholders.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide technical direction to engineering and delivery teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and provide implementation guidance.
* Present findings, recommendations, architectural decisions, and solution options to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Collaborate across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Required Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combinations of education, relevant certifications, and professional experience may be considered.

Experience

* Minimum of
  **5 years of professional experience**
  in AI, machine learning, software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale AI or machine learning solutions.
* Experience developing solutions using Python and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with cloud-based AI services and infrastructure, including Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services, and Databricks.
* Experience with generative AI technologies, large language models, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and business workflows.
* Experience establishing technical standards, reusable architecture patterns, or reference architectures.
* Experience moving AI solutions from proof of concept into secure and supportable production environments.

Required Knowledge and Skills

* Advanced knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI technologies.
* Strong understanding of large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Knowledge of AI solution architecture, system integration, application architecture, and data architecture.
* Understanding of cloud architecture, containerization, distributed systems, APIs, and modern deployment practices.
* Familiarity with structured and unstructured data management and analytics platforms, such as Databricks or comparable technologies.
* Knowledge of AI governance, model evaluation, validation methodologies, privacy, security, risk management, and responsible AI.
* Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend solutions based on business, architectural, security, and operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, data, security, or AI certifications.
* Experience working in healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with healthcare data, clinical systems, or electronic health record environments.
* Experience implementing AI governance, model monitoring, or AI risk-management frameworks.
* Experience guiding multidisciplinary teams through AI solution design and production implementation

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

As part of EY GDS-ServiceNow team, you will be solving client problems using the ServiceNow platform. You will get the opportunity to work with a high-performing team and drive innovative solutions that address complex client needs.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking a hands-on ServiceNow Technical Architect with deep expertise in Telecom Sales & Order Management (SOMT), enterprise integrations, and ServiceNow platform development. The ideal candidate will lead architecture and delivery while actively contributing to coding, configuration, troubleshooting, and mentoring teams. Experience with telecom OSS/BSS ecosystems, Performance Analytics, and AI capabilities is essential.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and deliver ServiceNow Sales & Order Management (SOM/SOMT) solutions for telecommunications clients.
* Lead discovery sessions, requirements workshops, solution design discussions, and stakeholder reviews.
* Design and implement integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, Scripted APIs, and MID Servers with external OSS/BSS, CRM, ERP, billing, and inventory systems.
* Remain hands-on by configuring and developing ServiceNow solutions, including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Flow Designer, Catalog Items, UI Actions, and custom applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex platform, integration, and production issues through root cause analysis and technical leadership.
* Lead development teams, conduct code reviews, enforce best practices, and drive technical governance.
* Mentor and train junior developers, providing technical guidance and capability development across the team.
* Leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities, automation, and Performance Analytics to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* ServiceNow SOM/SOMT, TSM, TNI, ITSM, CSM, FSM, CMDB/CSDM, integrations
* Telecom OSS/BSS integration experience.
* Performance Analytics, Now Assist, AI Agents, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Strong communication, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in a related technology field (Computer Science, Engineering, etc.) or equivalent experience
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* Minimum two (2) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications.
* 8+ years of ServiceNow experience, including architecture, development, and integration delivery.
* Strong hands-on scripting experience in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub.
* Proven experience in telecom order management, order orchestration, fulfillment, and Lead-to-Cash processes.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

title: Salesforce Technical Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

The
**Salesforce Technical Manager**
will bridge strategic solution design, enterprise delivery leadership, and hands-on technical management. This role serves as a key technical leader overseeing cross-functional engineering teams to design, build, and deploy scalable, enterprise-grade multi-cloud Salesforce solutions (Sales, Service, Experience/Community, Data Cloud, and AI).

You will manage end-to-end technical execution, enforce strict technical governance, architect secure integrations with legacy/third-party systems, drive DevOps maturity, and directly mentor development teams to deliver zero-defect implementations aligned with client goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architecture, Multi-Cloud & Solution Design**

* Blueprint and architect robust, end-to-end multi-cloud Salesforce solutions (Sales, Service, Experience/Community, and Data Cloud) aligned with enterprise business requirements.
* Lead the technology selection, application design, configuration, and custom component design for high-performance platform execution.
* Evaluate AI-driven features (Data Cloud, Agentforce) and modern platform capabilities to design future-ready systems.

**2. Enterprise Integration & Data Management**

* Architect and oversee programmatic integration topologies connecting Salesforce to external platforms, legacy ERPs (e.g., SAP, Oracle), and third-party middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, Boomi, CTI).
* Direct secure API orchestration, Single Sign-On (SSO), OAuth, JWT, and large-scale data migrations.
* Oversee large data volume (LDV) strategies, sharing models, and privacy controls across multi-org environments.

**3. Technical Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Direct day-to-day technical team activities, supervising custom development in Apex, LWC, Visualforce, and Flow Orchestration.
* Run mandatory code review sessions, enforce bulkification and governor limit patterns, and eliminate platform bottlenecks.
* Mentor and coach technical team members through developer and architect certification pathways, fostering a high-quality delivery culture.

**4. DevOps, Quality & Technical Governance**

* Establish and drive CI/CD release and environment automation pipelines using tools such as Git, Jenkins, Copado, Flosum, or GitHub Actions.
* Participate in Architectural Review Boards (ARB) to critique, standardize, and approve solution designs.
* Enforce native platform security controls, environment segregation, and corporate IT compliance standards across all project tracks.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Advisory**

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for client leadership, security boards, and key business stakeholders.
* Translate complex technical capabilities into strategic advice for non-technical business leaders.
* Collaborate closely with Solution Architects, Project/Delivery Managers, and sales teams to validate SOWs and project delivery constraints.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Total Experience:**
  12+ years in technical software engineering and development, with a minimum of 8+ years focused explicitly on Salesforce platform development and architecture.
* **Multi-Cloud Expertise:**
  Proven track record architecting and delivering solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience/Community Cloud; familiarity with Data Cloud or Marketing Cloud is highly desirable.
* **Core Technical Mastery:**
  5+ years of hands-on experience building custom solutions using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Visualforce, and Salesforce APIs.
* **Integration & Security:**
  Deep experience with integration patterns, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware orchestration, OAuth, SAML, and SSO.
* **DevOps & Release:**
  Demonstrated experience implementing automated CI/CD pipelines, source control strategies (Git), and sandbox/metadata management.
* **Methodology:**
  Proven history running technical delivery tracks in Agile frameworks across global onshore/offshore teams.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

**Preferred Certifications**

* **Architect Track:**
  Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect (CTA is a major advantage).
* **Development Track:**
  Platform Developer I & Platform Developer II.
* **Consulting/Cloud:**
  Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Data Cloud Consultant certifications.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Data Protection Field Engineer**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Field Engineer to help deploy, integrate, test, and troubleshoot AI\-enabled data protection solutions for global clients. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on helping clients secure sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, collaboration, and AI\-enabled environments by combining strong data protection fundamentals with practical AI engineering skills. The role is designed for professionals with early\-career to mid\-career experience who enjoy solving real client problems in delivery settings and building technical depth in modern data protection. The internal role design emphasizes deployment, model/platform integration, testing, and troubleshooting, while comparable market roles emphasize customer\-facing engineering, rapid iteration, and production\-grade solution delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Configure, deploy, and support AI\-enabled data protection capabilities across client environments, including data discovery, classification, DLP\-aligned controls, PKI/KMS integrations, and information rights management patterns.
* Integrate data protection platforms with AI models, copilots, and enterprise workflows to help clients protect sensitive information used in prompts, retrieval sources, generated outputs, and broader AI use cases.
* Execute implementation, validation, testing, and troubleshooting tasks for client deployments, including configuration tuning, issue identification, root\-cause analysis, and stabilization support.
* Support workshops, technical assessments, pilots, and proof\-of\-value activities by translating business and security requirements into practical engineering tasks. External field/FDE patterns emphasize embedding closely with customers and iterating quickly based on feedback, which should be reflected in this role.
* Contribute to reusable playbooks, deployment guides, code snippets, engineering templates, and configuration standards that improve repeatability across engagements. Reusable accelerators and reference implementations are a common requirement in comparable AI engineering roles.
* Work with cross\-functional teams spanning cybersecurity, privacy, AI engineering, cloud, and client stakeholders to deliver secure and workable outcomes.


**Required Qualifications**
* Up to 5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: data protection, DLP, information protection, data discovery/classification, security engineering, cloud security, or related cybersecurity engineering domains.
* Working knowledge of data protection fundamentals, including data discovery and classification, DLP concepts, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Practical familiarity with AI/ML concepts relevant to data protection, including machine learning, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring.
* Experience with at least some of the following tools/platforms: Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, VS Code with AI extensions, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Cyera, Varonis, Sentra, CrowdStrike Falcon DSPM, Wiz DSPM, Microsoft Purview, Python, TensorFlow.
* Strong troubleshooting mindset, structured communication, and comfort working in client\-facing delivery environments. Field engineering patterns from Microsoft and AI FDE patterns from the market both strongly emphasize technical depth plus customer communication.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview, DSPM, CASB, sensitivity labeling, data lineage, encryption, or privacy engineering.
* Experience writing small scripts, automations, or integrations in Python.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP, and basic understanding of APIs and enterprise integrations. Comparable AI delivery roles frequently require these capabilities.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

* Typical work environment
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

title: Engineering Lead - AI
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY Job Description**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross\-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology \| CBS Technology \| Intelligent Automation**
**Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI \& Automation**
**Job Summary:**
 The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands\-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production\-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
   

  

 Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
   

  

**The ideal candidate will possess:**
* Extensive, hands\-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant outcomes.
* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and data\-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non\-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production\-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM\-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.
* Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI\-first architectures, including LLM\-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems.
* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real\-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.


**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Engineering Ownership \& Delivery Accountability
+ Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:
- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade\-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go\-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.


* Hands\-on GenAI \& AI Systems Engineering
* 
+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production\-grade GenAI systems, including:
- Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool\-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human\-in\-the\-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:
- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.


* Architecture \& Engineering Standards
+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:
- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud\-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.


* AI Platform Engineering \& MLOps / LLMOps
+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:
- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non\-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.


* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI \& Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:
- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production\-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.


* Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
+ Partner closely with:
- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.


**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**
* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production\-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go\-live, including reliability and cost optimization.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
 **real, reliable, and scalable systems** 
 —not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Python, Java, C\#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API\-driven, cloud\-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.


**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered applications, including:
+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool\-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:
+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.


**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**
* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.


**Detailed Responsibilities:**
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end\-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision\-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.


**Other Requirements:**
* Familiarity with Python practices and tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
* A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience


**Experience:**
* 10\+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
* 3\+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
* 3\+ Years in a global operations environment


**Certification Requirements:**
* Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**The Role** 




 As a Platform Engineer in the Data \& Analytics team, you’ll sit at the vital intersection between software engineering and infrastructure. Your mission is to ensurethat the systemswe build are not only functional, but also resilient, observable, performant, and production ready.
 



 You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, and the central infrastructure team to design and support the environments, tooling, and operational practicesthat power our data platform.From CI/CD pipelines to database performance tuning, observability, and scaling strategy — you’ll be the expert who helps us build mechanical sympathy between our code and the systems it runs on.
 



 This is a hands\-on, enablingrole ideal for someone who loves helpingteams ship great software safelyand reliably.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and evolve the CI/CD pipelines for the Data Platform, supporting fast, safe, and repeatable deployments.
* Enhance observability across services, pipelines, and data flows, supporting logs, metrics, tracing, and alerts.
* Monitor and optimize databaseperformance, availability, and access patterns.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teamsto ensure HA, disaster recovery, and scaling strategies are in place and well understood.
* Partner with engineers to define best practices for environment management, secrets, configuration, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Support the team in diagnosing and resolving production issues and in building systemsthat are easier to debug and maintain.
* Identify and reduce operational friction, creating tools or automations where needed to improve reliability and developer velocity.



  





  





 Essential Criteria
 



  




* Strong experience working with CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application performance tooling.
* Practical knowledge of observability stacks— including metrics,logs, dashboards, and alerting.
* Hands\-on experience with databases(e.g. PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or cloud\-native DBs), including monitoring and tuning.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (preferably AWS), containerization, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation).
* A collaborative mindset, able to work across engineering and infrastructure teamsto solve shared problems.
* Passion for enabling others,improving developer experience, and building reliablesystems.



  





  





 Desirable Criteria
 


* Experience supporting data pipelines, analytics platforms, or distributed systems at scale.
* Familiarity with data management frameworks (e.g. AWS Glue, Temporal) and performance profiling in data\-intensive environments.
* Exposure to monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana,Datadog, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry.
* Understanding of security best practices relatedto data platforms, secrets management, and access control.
* Knowledge of container orchestration and serverless deployment patterns (e.g. ECS, Fargate, Lambda).



  





  





 What We Offer
 


* A unique opportunity to shape the operational backboneof our company’s data platform.
* A collaborative engineering culturewhere operational excellence is valued and supported.
* The freedom to improvehow things are built, deployed,and run with real impact.
* A close partnership with experienced engineersand infrastructure specialists.
* A modern, cloud\-native stackand a platform that’s scalingrapidly.

title: CDP Engineer
description:
**Responsibilities**
* Configure and maintain CDP data models, audience/segment definitions, and identity resolution.
* Build and maintain CDP integrations with Databricks/Delta Lake (zero\-copy access patterns).
* Design and maintain event streaming integration using AWS MSK (Kafka), including external publishing.
* Build, configure, and maintain destination connectors to Adobe Campaign Classic (email), Airship (push), and Infobip (SMS).
* Build and support journeys/orchestration logic, including governance and suppression across overlapping member experiences.
* Support integration work for experimentation/personalization layers (e.g., Optimizely, Bloomreach) consuming CDP\-supplied segmentation.
* Build ingestion pipelines for engagement feedback loops (delivery/engagement events flowing back into Databricks).
* Scope and deliver platform enhancements as new use cases, channels, audiences, or business requirements emerge.
* Partner with product/marketing stakeholders to translate business requirements into CDP configuration and logic.
* Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve platform issues raised by business/marketing stakeholders (e.g., segment/audience errors, sync failures, journey/campaign delivery issues, data discrepancies).
* Perform root\-cause analysis on production issues and implement fixes or workarounds.
* Monitor platform health (sync jobs, journey runs, data freshness, audience counts) and proactively flag/address problems.
* Maintain documentation for platform configuration, data flows, API contracts, and known issues/resolutions.
* Participate in vendor working sessions to define technical requirements and surface product gaps.


**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years working directly in/on a CDP or similar MarTech data platform (configuration, activation, and support)
* Hands\-on experience with audience/segment building, identity resolution, and journey/orchestration tooling
* Strong Databricks and Delta Lake experience (Unity Catalog, data\-sharing connectivity)
* AWS experience, particularly MSK/Kafka.
* REST API integration experience with marketing execution platforms (ESP, push, SMS providers)
* Adobe Campaign Classic experience \- hands\-on with workflows, campaign/journey setup, and API\-based integration
* API\-first, composable architecture / connector\-based integration experience
* Experience implementing/maintaining a CDP Web SDK or similar client\-side event tracking SDK (JavaScript) for behavioral/event data capture
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills; comfortable being a hands\-on point of contact for business\-reported issues
* Strong technical skills


 Support CDP (Customer Data Platform) as part of the Personalization Program covering platform configuration, audience/segmentation build, journey/orchestration support, integrations, enhancements, and ongoing production support. This is a broad CDP role, not limited to integration work, it includes building and maintaining segments, campaigns/journeys, governance and suppression logic, and troubleshooting issues across the platform end\-to\-end.

* Database \& APIs: Solid understanding of REST APIs, SQL databases, authentication schemes, and third\-party integrations.

**Bonus Points**
* Knowledge/experience with additional Cloudflare ecosystem products (KV, R2, Queues).
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and containerisation workflows.
* Prior experience building Shopify apps, SaaS products, or e\-commerce integrations.

* High Scale \& Impact: Build software used by thousands of global brands and millions of end consumers.

title: O9 Engineer
description:
Experience \- 5 plus years
   

  

 We are hiring an O9 Solutions Engineer to support and evolve the O9 platform for one of the largest retailers in the United States. O9 is the system of record for demand forecasting, supply planning, and allocation decisions across our brands, regions, and channels. This role owns the day\-to\-day health of the platform — triaging and resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity between O9 and upstream/downstream systems such as Oracle EBS, and partnering with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Merchandising teams to keep the platform reliable, accurate, and easy to use across a global user base (US, UK, EMEA, and APAC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as a primary point of support for O9 Supply Planning and Demand Planning modules, triaging incidents end\-to\-end from intake through root\-cause and resolution.
* Investigate and resolve data integrity issues between O9 and connected systems (Oracle EBS, RMA/returns feeds, buy\-plan and sourcing extracts), including mismatched quantities, missing style\-colors, and forecast data not flowing between planning modules.
* Diagnose and fix planning logic issues — unmet demand, incorrect season codes, planned orders not grouping correctly, buy dates shifting unexpectedly, and similar planning\-engine anomalies.
* Manage user access and provisioning (new hires, role changes, regional access, ownership transfers) and drive toward self\-service or bulk\-provisioning workflows to reduce manual ticket volume.
* Own incident and backlog hygiene: track SLAs, prioritize aging tickets, and ensure nothing sits unresolved for months without visibility to stakeholders.
* Partner with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and regional business teams (US, UK, China, Japan) to translate business\-reported issues into technical root causes.
* Build and maintain runbooks, root\-cause documentation, and knowledge base articles so common issues can be resolved consistently — not just by institutional memory.
* Support configuration changes, workflow updates, and enhancements within O9 as the retailer's planning processes evolve (new brands, new seasons, new regions).
* Participate in O9 platform upgrades, testing cycles, and post\-implementation review (PIR) processes for major changes.
* Escalate to and collaborate with O9 Solutions' vendor support team on platform\-level defects that require vendor engineering involvement.
* Skillset
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting or implementing O9\.
* Solid understanding of retail supply chain planning concepts: demand forecasting, supply/buy planning, allocation, assortment, and season/style\-color management.
* Experience integrating planning systems with ERP platforms, ideally Oracle EBS, including familiarity with common data reconciliation issues between planning and execution systems.
* Strong troubleshooting skills — comfortable reading data flows end\-to\-end to isolate whether an issue originates in source data, integration, or planning logic.
* Experience with incident management tools (ServiceNow or similar) and a track record of managing ticket queues, SLAs, and prioritization in a production support environment.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data investigation and validation.
* Excellent written communication skills — you'll be documenting root causes and explaining technical issues to non\-technical business stakeholders across time zones.
* Comfortable working with global, cross\-regional teams (US, EMEA, APAC) and adjusting communication style accordingly.
