title: Product Architect
description:
**About KeyValue** 




  





 KeyValue is a premier global AI\-driven product development hub, dedicated to transforming ideas into scalable and impactful software products. With expertise across diverse industries, we deliver high\-quality solutions with the power of AI and automation. As an AI\-first organisation, we strive to push the boundaries of technology, offering accelerated, flexible and cost\-effective product development.
 



  





 We have ideated, conceived, strategized and built some of the globe’s most innovative Fintech, Payments, Financial Services, Digital Commerce, Madtech, Edtech, Socialtech, Logistics, High Technology, Blockchain, Crypto, NFT and Healthcare companies, helping them conceive, scale, pivot and enhance their businesses.
 



  





 KeyValue’s mission is to be the world’s most trusted product development hub – delivering high\-value outcomes for start\-ups \& scale\-ups – with a talented skilled team – in a thriving and inclusive culture.
 



 We're looking for a
 **Product Architect** 
 to own the technical direction of our products end to end from the first architecture decision to systems running reliably at scale. You'll set the technical bar, make the hard calls on architecture and technology and lead engineers through complex problems. Just as important: you'll be the person who spots the problem early
 *and* 
 brings the solution, working shoulder to shoulder with product, engineering and business teams.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Own product architecture from concept and technology choices all the way through to systems running in production at scale.
* Translate product and business requirements into clear technical designs covering system architecture, APIs, data models, integrations and infrastructure.
* Make and defend key architectural decisions while weighing performance, security, reliability, maintainability and cost.
* Stay hands\-on by contributing to critical design and coding decisions rather than just diagrams.
* Catch architectural risks and bottlenecks early and drive the fixes before they become blockers.
* Lead engineers through hard technical problems and keep architecture consistent across teams.
* Run architecture, design and code reviews and raise the engineering bar through best practices and mentoring.
* Evaluate AI, automation and emerging tech for real product use, focusing on signal rather than hype.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 6\+ years of experience in building and shipping software products, with strong hands\-on engineering depth.
* Hands\-on experience building AI/LLM\-enabled products or working with AI\-assisted development.
* Strong expertise in software architecture, system design, design patterns and data structures and algorithms.
* Proven experience with microservices, distributed systems, event\-driven and high\-availability architectures.
* Strong in one or more backend languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, Go, Scala, or Rust.
* Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases, API design across REST and GraphQL and system integrations.
* Hands\-on with AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud\-native patterns.
* Good grasp of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, testing and production reliability.
* A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into clear technical direction and getting a team to rally behind it.
* A sharp communicator who can explain trade\-offs to engineers, product and business teams alike.

**Job Description**
 I\&O Platform Infrastructure Application Performance Management and Logging (ELK) SME

**The opportunity**
 In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology, we are looking for a proven Application Performance Management (APM) and Logging SME to support and evolve EY's monitoring and observability platforms globally. The role will provide engineering leadership, operational support, automation and lifecycle management for the firm's APM tooling and the ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) stack. The successful candidate will work with cutting\-edge observability technologies, driving platform maturity, operational excellence and engineering innovation across EY's global infrastructure estate.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 The I\&O Platform Infrastructure APM and Logging SME provides technical leadership and engineering of complex nature for the firm's application performance monitoring and centralized logging platforms. This professional applies knowledge of APM solutions, the ELK stack, log management, metrics pipelines and distributed tracing to support enterprise\-scale workloads and enable rapid incident response.
   

  

 The role requires deep knowledge of the firm's infrastructure monitoring landscape to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, onboarding programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The SME will serve as the subject matter authority for APM and logging platforms, partnering with application teams, infrastructure engineers and security stakeholders across global locations to ensure observability coverage, data quality and platform reliability.
   

  

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong experience designing, deploying and administering ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) at enterprise scale.
* Deep knowledge of APM tooling (e.g., Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM, New Relic or equivalent).
* Experience architecting centralized logging solutions and log aggregation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of metrics, traces and logs as the three pillars of observability.
* Experience with Elasticsearch cluster management, index lifecycle management (ILM) and snapshot/restore.
* Knowledge of Logstash pipeline development and Beats (Filebeat, Metricbeat, Winlogbeat) deployment.
* Experience building Kibana dashboards, visualizations and alerting rules.
* Experience with log parsing, field extraction, grok patterns and data enrichment.
* Knowledge of distributed tracing frameworks and instrumentation approaches.
* Strong scripting and automation skills, including:
+ Python
+ PowerShell
+ Bash / Shell scripting

* Experience integrating monitoring platforms with ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation, runbooks and operational procedures.
* Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
* Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams across multiple time zones.


**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**
* ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) — enterprise\-scale deployment and administration. 7\+ years.
* APM platform engineering and administration (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM or equivalent). 7\+ years.
* Centralized logging architecture design and operations. 7\+ years.
* Elasticsearch cluster management, performance tuning and capacity planning. 7\+ years.
* Logstash pipeline development and Beats agent fleet management. 5–7 years.
* Kibana dashboard and visualization development. 5–7 years.
* Index lifecycle management (ILM), hot\-warm\-cold architecture and data tiering. 5–7 years.
* Log parsing, grok pattern development and field enrichment. 5–7 years.
* Metrics collection frameworks (Prometheus, InfluxDB, StatsD or equivalent).
* Distributed tracing — implementation, instrumentation and analysis.
* Alert management and notification workflows across monitoring platforms.
* SIEM integration and security event log forwarding.
* TLS/SSL configuration and security hardening of ELK components.
* Role\-based access control (RBAC) within Elasticsearch and Kibana.
* Containerized deployment of ELK components (Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift).
* CI/CD pipeline integration for monitoring\-as\-code and configuration management.
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity planning for monitoring platforms.
* Performance troubleshooting of high\-ingestion Elasticsearch clusters (50 GB\+/day).
* Onboarding application and infrastructure teams onto APM and logging platforms.
* Windows and Linux systems administration supporting ELK infrastructure.


**Ideally, you'll also have**
* Elastic Certified Engineer or Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
* Dynatrace Associate or Professional certification (desired).
* Microsoft Azure Administrator or equivalent cloud certification (desired).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards and collector configuration.
* Experience with Elastic Cloud or Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes (ECK).
* Familiarity with cloud\-native logging solutions (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, GCP Cloud Logging).
* Experience operating in a managed service or large enterprise shared services environment.


**What We Look For**
 An experienced and technically deep observability engineer and leader to help build, operate and modernize EY's APM and centralized logging platforms. We are looking for an individual with proven expertise in ELK stack engineering, strong APM platform knowledge, a passion for operational excellence and automation, and the ability to serve as the technical authority for monitoring and observability across EY's global infrastructure estate.

**Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)**
**Description**
 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability \& reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops
   

  

 A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance.
   

  

 An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability \& automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
* Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
* Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e.g., Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
* Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
* Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra \& Operations \- FinOps
* Critical Situation management
* SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
* Data Analytics \& System trend analysis


**Typical Skills And Background**
* 7\+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
* Hands\-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
* Hands\-on experience in at least one CI\-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc.)
* Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc.) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc.)
* Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
* Experience in Observability \- APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc.), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
* Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
* Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc.
* Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
* Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot \& Cloud native architectures
* Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
* Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
* Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
* Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation \& analysis
* Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs \& models
